'''Simmons''' was a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Republic Army]] who led a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During one part of the battle, Simmons was in contact with [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Tott]] via [[Holocomm/Legends|holocomm]], and was ordered to move the squad out of range of the Imperial artillery in the [[Axial Park]] region of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]].
